company.name: FlutterFlow
company.shortDescription: FlutterFlow is a low-code, visual application development platform for native mobile and web applications.
company.description:
FlutterFlow, founded in 2020, is a ground breaking low-code, visual development platform designed to simplify the creation of native mobile and web applications. With over 400,000 users and thousands of apps deployed to app stores, FlutterFlow empowers product teams to create stunning UIs and generate clean code with ease. The platform's one-click deployment feature accelerates launch timelines, while remaining fully extensible with custom code. Millions of end users are served through FlutterFlow-built apps. This cutting-edge platform streamlines application development and enables businesses to scale rapidly and efficiently.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NimXzr4LYWE
